integrity: Finite exhaustive proof steps and a standalone standard-library verifier are supplied; computations have been reviewed in the same-model process but not independently externally audited.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite result for the 14-vertex Heawood graph only; not an asymptotic forcing theorem. Prior unindexed enumerations remain possible.
title: Four-set obstructions and two optimal forcing-triple types in the Heawood graph
